== Healing ability ==

Do you think that Nynaeve might be able to heal death itself. She has healed many things that did not seem possible to other Aes sedai and it has been mentioned so many times that death can't be healed. It would make sense that Nynaeve being arguably the greatest healer of the age and perhaps of the age of legends, could make this happen.
